subject: gina@fabrikam.example
title: Privileged user can register a synced passkey
action: Exclude privileged users from the target(s) 'Contractors' of the loose profile (e.g. scope it to a group that excludes admins), and scope admins only to a device-bound, attested profile.
detail: gina@fabrikam.example (Exchange Administrator) can register: Synced passkey, any provider, unattested. Their stricter admin profile is overridden.

subject: liam@fabrikam.example
title: SMS/voice-only user
action: Have the user register a passkey (device-bound preferred) before the deadline.
detail: liam@fabrikam.example relies only on sms. Blocking registration prompt from 1 Feb 2027.

subject: hank@fabrikam.example
title: Registered passkey not accepted by any scoped profile
action: Add AAGUID cb69481e-8ff7-4039-93ec-0a2729a154a8 to an allow list that covers this user, or have them register a permitted key before the change lands.
detail: hank@fabrikam.example's key 'YubiKey 5' (AAGUID cb69481e-8ff7-4039-93ec-0a2729a154a8) satisfies none of their profiles.

subject: jack@fabrikam.example
title: Registered passkey not accepted by any scoped profile
action: Add AAGUID a4e9fc6d-4cbe-4758-b8ba-37598bb5bbaa to an allow list that covers this user, or have them register a permitted key before the change lands.
detail: jack@fabrikam.example's key 'YubiKey 5 NFC (FW 5.7)' (AAGUID a4e9fc6d-4cbe-4758-b8ba-37598bb5bbaa) satisfies none of their profiles.

subject: Contractors
title: Policy group can be changed by non-privileged admins
action: Use a role-assignable group (isAssignableToRole = true, no owners) for this target, so only Privileged Role Administrators can change it.
detail: 'Contractors' targets a passkey profile that allows synced passkeys but is not role-assignable. Adding an admin to it lets them register a synced passkey (R1).

subject: Admins - security keys (attested)
title: Attested profile lists synced passkeys
action: Remove 'synced' from this profile, or drop the attestation claim and document it as a synced profile.
detail: 'Admins - security keys (attested)' requires attestation and also lists synced passkeys. Synced passkeys cannot be attested, so that setting is dead weight and suggests a misunderstanding.

subject: Admins - security keys (attested)
title: Attested profile is bypassed by an overlapping profile
action: Remove the users of 'Admins - security keys (attested)' from the targets of looser profiles, or accept that 'Admins - security keys (attested)' is not an attestation control for them.
detail: 1 of 2 users scoped to attested profile 'Admins - security keys (attested)' can still register unattested passkeys through another profile.

subject: tenant
title: Registration campaign is off
action: Enable the registration campaign for the SMS/voice cohort, targeting passkeys, with limited snoozes.
detail: 1 SMS/voice-only user(s) and no registration campaign to nudge them before the deadline.

subject: gina@fabrikam.example
title: Temporary Access Pass can bootstrap a new passkey on an admin
action: Exclude admin groups from the TAP policy (issue admin TAPs through a break-glass process), or set isUsableOnce = true and a maximum lifetime of 60 minutes or less.
detail: 1 other user(s) can issue gina@fabrikam.example a TAP and register a passkey with it.

subject: jack@fabrikam.example
title: Temporary Access Pass can bootstrap a new passkey on an admin
action: Exclude admin groups from the TAP policy (issue admin TAPs through a break-glass process), or set isUsableOnce = true and a maximum lifetime of 60 minutes or less.
detail: 0 other user(s) can issue jack@fabrikam.example a TAP and register a passkey with it.

subject: Pilot (unused)
title: Profile not targeted by any group
action: Target it at the intended group or delete it.
detail: 'Pilot (unused)' is defined but no include target uses it. It protects nobody.

subject: tenant
title: Many passkey profiles
action: Consolidate to an admin profile and a workforce profile where possible.
detail: 4 profiles (soft threshold 3). More profiles mean more overlap to reason about.

subject: Workforce - Authenticator only
title: Authenticator AAGUIDs in allow list
action: Confirm Authenticator passkeys are intended for the users of this profile.
detail: 'Workforce - Authenticator only' allows Microsoft Authenticator AAGUIDs, which Entra adds automatically when Authenticator passkeys are enabled.
